spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (चिकित्सति)
1 To cure, to administer remedies, to practise physic.
2 To remove, to destroy.
3 To chastise.
4 (Usually with वि prefixed,) To doubt; this root is regular.
r. 3rd cl. (चिकेति)
To know.
r. 10th cl. (केतयति)
1 To dwell.
2 To desire; some authorities make it a regular root of the 1st cl. in these senses, and others deny its admitting of any conjugation.

mfn. (-वः-वा-वं)
1 A gamester, a gambler.
2 A cheat, cheating, fraudulent.
3 Mad, crazy.
4 Mischievous, malicious.
m. (-वः)
1 Thorn apple, (Datura metel.)
2 A kind of perfume, commonly Rocanā.
E.
किं what, तव yours, (what is your stake or wager?) he who asks such a question, &c.
